entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`package_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `variant_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `product_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `brand` TEXT NOT NULL, `material` TEXT NOT NULL, `product` TEXT NOT NULL, `color_name` TEXT NOT NULL, `color_hex` TEXT NOT NULL, `diameter_mm` TEXT NOT NULL, `mass_g` INTEGER NOT NULL, `nozzle_min_c` INTEGER, `nozzle_max_c` INTEGER, `bed_min_c` INTEGER, `bed_max_c` INTEGER, `gtin` TEXT, `sku` TEXT, `source_revision` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`package_id`))
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`brand` TEXT NOT NULL, `material` TEXT NOT NULL, `product` TEXT NOT NULL, `color_name` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`catalog_entries`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_catalog_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `catalog_entries` BEGIN DELETE FROM `catalog_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_catalog_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `catalog_entries` BEGIN DELETE FROM `catalog_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_catalog_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `catalog_entries` BEGIN INSERT INTO `catalog_fts`(`docid`, `brand`, `material`, `product`, `color_name`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`brand`, NEW.`material`, NEW.`product`, NEW.`color_name`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_catalog_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `catalog_entries` BEGIN INSERT INTO `catalog_fts`(`docid`, `brand`, `material`, `product`, `color_name`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`brand`, NEW.`material`, NEW.`product`, NEW.`color_name`); END
